nodes.label: Architecture Trade-offs (First Law)
nodes.rationale: Everything in software architecture is a trade-off. Improving one characteristic (e.g., performance) often degrades another (e.g., scalability). The Second Law states: Why is more important than how.

nodes.label: require-ci-before-merge Setting
nodes.rationale: Three values: false (default, merge immediately), true (require green CI gate, even if no pipeline), if-present (gate on CI when checks exist, otherwise merge). Designed to support repos that cannot configure GitHub required status checks (e.g., private repos on free plan).

nodes.label: Duplicate PR Winner Selection Criteria
nodes.rationale: Tie-break by lowest PR number (deterministic) so two agents independently evaluating the same set always agree on the winner and never close each other's keeper.

nodes.label: CI Gate Enforcement (GitHub vs Plugin-side)
nodes.rationale: Auto-merge is only safe with either (a) GitHub-enforced required status checks (unavailable on private repos on free plan) or (b) plugin-side require-ci-before-merge:true. Private repos on free plan cannot use (a), so (b) is the only gate. /github-workflow:setup harden detects the 403 and sets require-ci-before-merge:true automatically.

nodes.label: PR Claim Concurrency Rules (Atomic Ref Lock)
nodes.rationale: Real lock is refs/claims/pr-N, not a label. Labels are only human-visible display markers. A reviewer and updater on the same identity cannot race because both claim the same ref via compare-and-swap. Label checks are a cheap first filter; atomic claim is the authoritative gate.
nodes.norm_label: pr claim concurrency rules (atomic ref lock)

nodes.label: Execute Exit Cleanup (Claim Release + Scratch + Tree)
nodes.rationale: Every exit path must leave three things clean: atomic claim ref, per-session scratch file (.claude/plan.md), and working tree. Worktree auto-removal only fires on clean trees, so leftover uncommitted changes pin worktrees open forever.
nodes.norm_label: execute exit cleanup (claim release + scratch + tree)

nodes.label: Deferred Speccing (Large Features)
nodes.rationale: When a large feature produces more than 4 stories, fully spec only the first 2-3 in the dependency chain and defer the rest with needs-refinement label. Prevents speccing work that may change as dependencies are resolved.

nodes.label: Preflight Critical vs Warning Classification
nodes.rationale: Only CRITICAL items block a command (missing auth, missing ClaudeProject.md, required board unconfigured). WARNINGs proceed on defaults. Defaults-first principle: everything that can default does default at runtime.
